Weeks (you need 500 votes earned in the Oramond Quest tasks)

Also known as *Voting Quest*. You earn votes by doing tasks in the {wiki:Oramond Quest} and spend them with {npc:Marvin} in the Rathleton Magistrate to decide shortcuts, dungeon monsters, bosses and raids. With each votes tier you go up a rank (Commoner, Inhabitant, Citizen and Squire), get an achievement and unlock new perks: selling loot to NPCs, Slime Slide, boat trips to more cities, the Underground Glooth Factory and the {wiki:Hero of Rathleton Quest}.
The magistrates of Rathleton will gladly promote you in their ranks if you meet their requirements.
No minimum level; **recommended level 150+** (to do the Oramond Quest tasks that give the votes).
Votes (voting rights) earned from {wiki:Oramond Quest} tasks: 50 for Commoner, 150 in total for Inhabitant, 300 for Citizen and 500 for Squire.
No specific item: only votes, earned from Oramond Quest tasks
Being able to vote on several topics (shortcut, dungeon, boss and raid)
**Inhabitant:** sell weapons and armour from local creatures to {npc:Flint}

**Citizen:** {item:Slime Slide} between the boat and Rathleton without passing the minotaurs; travel from Oramond to Edron, Venore, Port Hope, Krailos, Issavi or Travora; access to the {wiki:Underground Glooth Factory}
**Squire:** you can start the {wiki:Hero of Rathleton Quest}
Achievements **Rathleton Commoner**, **Rathleton Inhabitant**, **Rathleton Citizen** and **Rathleton Squire**
Oramond votes (shortcut, dungeon, bosses and raids)
With no rank you vote on the shortcut; as **Commoner** also on the dungeon; as **Inhabitant** also on the bosses.
Votes are earned from Oramond Quest tasks and reset to zero every 14 days.
After casting at least **50 votes** with {npc:Marvin}.
Selling Oramond Creature Products to Alaistar
Selling local creature weapons and armours to Flint
On reaching the **Inhabitant** rank (150 votes in total).
Direct Slime Slide between the boat and Rathleton
On reaching the **Citizen** rank (300 votes in total).
Avoids going past the minotaurs and also works for getting back to the boat.
Boats from Oramond to Edron, Venore, Port Hope, Krailos, Issavi and Travora
On reaching the **Citizen** rank (300 votes in total).
The boats from Edron and Venore to Oramond also require this rank; the one from Thais does not.
On reaching the **Citizen** rank (300 votes in total), which lets you use the Slime Slide.
On reaching the **Squire** rank (500 votes in total).

If you want the addons of the {wiki:Glooth Engineer Outfits|Glooth Engineer Outfits}, vote **at least once** for each option under **shortcut**, **dungeon** and **boss** (9 votes in total). Raids don't count. The base outfit comes from the {wiki:Dark Trails Quest}.
Votes are counted every two weeks (every other Monday, starting on the first Monday after the {wiki:Tibiadrome} reset), at server save. The results appear on the {wiki:The Voting Results} board.
Each vote can go to a different topic, or you can put them all into the same vote. Promotions depend on the total number of votes you have already cast.

Rathleton is on the island of **Oramond**. There is a boat to Oramond from Thais ({npc:Captain Bluebear}), Edron ({npc:Captain Seahorse}) or Venore ({npc:Captain Fearless}): say {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes}. You disembark on the raft of {npc:Captain Gulliver}, **west** of Oramond. Step into the {item:Slime Slide}: it takes you to a mound on the main island. Go down to ground level and walk **east** to some buildings with a small boat; the portal on that boat takes you across the water. From there go **north** to the main gate of Rathleton.

To leave Oramond, walk the arrival route in reverse (or, from the Citizen rank, use the Slime Slide in Rathleton that leads to the boat) and talk to {npc:Captain Gulliver}: {key:hi}, the name of the city (for example {key:thais}, {key:edron} or {key:venore}) and {key:yes}.
Do {wiki:Oramond Quest} tasks in Rathleton/Oramond. Each completed task gives you voting points (voting rights) to spend with {npc:Marvin}.

Go to the {wiki:Rathleton Magistrate} and talk to {npc:Marvin}: {key:hi}, {key:voting}. He asks whether you want to learn more ({key:learn}), see your votes ({key:amount}), your rank ({key:status}) or vote on a topic ({key:topic}).

With no rank you can only vote on the **shortcut** back to Rathleton. Tell {npc:Marvin}: {key:hi}, {key:voting}, {key:topic}, {key:shortcut} and choose an option; then say the number of votes and {key:yes}.
The shortcut with the most votes is built and can be used. Every 14 days the votes reset to zero and the most popular option at that time takes effect.
After casting **50 votes**, tell {npc:Marvin} {key:hi} and {key:promotion} (you can confirm your rank with {key:status}).
Commoner rank + **Rathleton Commoner** achievement; you can sell Oramond Creature Products to {npc:Alaistar}

As a Commoner you can also vote on the *wish list*: which creatures fill the {wiki:Oramond Dungeon}. Tell {npc:Marvin}: {key:hi}, {key:voting}, {key:topic}, {key:dungeon}, the option, the number of votes and {key:yes}.
The creatures with the most votes fill the dungeon; the votes reset to zero every 14 days.
With **150 votes** cast in total, tell {npc:Marvin} {key:hi} and {key:promotion}.
Inhabitant rank + **Rathleton Inhabitant** achievement; you can sell weapons and armour from local creatures to {npc:Flint}
As an Inhabitant you can vote on which **boss** appears. Tell {npc:Marvin}: {key:hi}, {key:voting}, {key:topic}, {key:bosses}, the boss name, the number of votes and {key:yes}.
The boss with the most votes is the one that appears; the votes reset to zero every 14 days.
With **300 votes** cast in total, tell {npc:Marvin} {key:hi} and {key:promotion}.

Cast 200 more votes on any topic. For example, on raids: {key:hi}, {key:voting}, {key:topic}, {key:raid}, then {key:minotaurs}, {key:mechanical creatures} or {key:wild life}, the number of votes and {key:yes}.
With **500 votes** cast in total, tell {npc:Marvin} {key:hi} and {key:promotion}.
Squire rank + **Rathleton Squire** achievement; you can start the {wiki:Hero of Rathleton Quest}
